q: In the fraud-2025 project, what is fraud25-gbm-v2?
a: The 2025 card-not-present champion LightGBM fraud model, promoted 2025-06-30 (dec-f25-champion-v2) and trained on 2024-07 to 2025-03 CNP transactions. It replaced fraud25-gbm-v1 and reached AUC 0.911 and KS 0.66 on holdout-2025q1 (exp-104).

q: What came of the 0.62 alert threshold sweep in fraud-2025 (exp-103)?
a: exp-103 (2025-05-27) gave a 0.9% alert rate, 14.2% precision and 0.58 recall at 0.62, which led to dec-f25-threshold-062 (2025-06-24). The 0.62 cut-off was later found to over-flag travel (fraud25-find-travel-overflag) and was replaced by 0.70 in dec-f25-threshold-070.

q: What does fraud25-gbm-v2 use as input features in fraud-2025?
a: fraud25-gbm-v2 uses feat-f25-velocity-v1, feat-f25-device-age, feat-f25-mcc-travel, feat-f25-amt-ratio and feat-f25-hour-band, trained on ds-f25-txn-2024-2025 with labels from ds-f25-labels.

q: What is the current alert threshold for the fraud-2025 champion?
a: 0.70, set by dec-f25-threshold-070 on 2025-10-08 for fraud25-gbm-v2. It superseded the 0.62 cut-off of dec-f25-threshold-062, and it still over-flags travel because fraud25-gbm-v3 was not promoted.

q: What AUC and KS did fraud25-gbm-v2 reach on holdout-2025q1?
a: AUC 0.911 and KS 0.66 on holdout-2025q1 (1,104,800 transactions, 2,310 fraud), evaluated 2025-06-12 in exp-104.

q: Why was fraud25-gbm-v3 not promoted in fraud-2025?
a: dec-f25-no-v3 (2025-10-01): v3 halved the travel flag and cut travel's share of alerts from 31% to 17%, but recall at 0.62 fell from 0.58 to 0.57 and fraud ops wanted labels reviewed first, so the rebuild was deferred to 2026.
